title: A pilot invitation goes only to its own customer after aMember says yes, once, within the budget and pacing; its unsubscribe link suppresses that address
steps: Run the send ledger, config, unsubscribe wiring and mounted UI suites from this branch against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL), with the fake Google that counts every messages.send and a fake aMember.
expect: In test mode the invitation door answers REAL_PILOT_OFF; in pilot mode one approved draft makes exactly one messages.send to the recipient's own address, with no [Test] prefix and no X-Tracy-Test header.
The message carries List-Unsubscribe with a one-click token, List-Unsubscribe-Post, the footer reason line and unsubscribe link; the placeholder is gone.

A second invitation to the same customer answers REAL_ALREADY_INVITED; aMember no plan answers REAL_NOT_MEMBER, an aMember error or no key answers REAL_MEMBERSHIP_UNKNOWN; a full budget answers REAL_PILOT_FULL; a second customer inside 180 s answers REAL_PILOT_PACING.

GET of the unsubscribe link changes nothing; the one-click POST writes one suppression row whose identity holds no address; a later send to that address answers REAL_SUPPRESSED; an unknown token answers 404.
Through the full app, the one-click POST with no cookie and no Origin is not refused by the cross-site guard.
Pilot without AMEMBER_API_KEY reads as test and lists what is missing.
Send to customer needs a second press and posts only requestKey and draftRevision.
fence: Fake Google and fake aMember only; no credential, no real mailbox, no customer address. Private PostgreSQL and a temporary key vault.

tests: a pilot invitation goes to the customer's own address after aMember says yes, with a live unsubscribe
a pilot invitation is refused without aMember yes, past the budget, inside pacing or when suppressed
the invitation unsubscribe doors are mounted and pass the cross-site guard without a session
Send to customer asks once more, then posts no address; the server picks the customer
